agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario starts near-upright (theta=0.1) but with near-max sensor noise (0.017) and near-max dt (0.02). Noisy angle/rate measurements cause the fixed state-feedback controller to apply large wrong-direction forces (15-24 N by steps 5-12), accelerating the cart (v 1.3 at step5 to 5.3 at step15) and pumping energy (1.28 to 17.0) instead of stabilizing. Pole swings from +0.1 to -0.46 by step12, -0.72 by step14, -0.868 by step15, violating pole_upright. Zeroing only sensor_noise leaves the run stable, confirming noise-driven feedback destabilization at coarse dt.
